description: Totals for yourself over a period: working minutes, work days (出勤日数), holiday-work days (休日出勤), and an ESTIMATE of statutory overtime (法定時間外の目安), per month. Defaults: the 1st of this month through today, Japan time, YYYY-MM-DD (max 366 days). Always repeat disclaimer to the user; the number is not an official overtime total. Team risk is find_overtime_risks (admin). What the employee should fix is close_out, which already includes this estimate.

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the 1st of this month.

to.description: End date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

name: summarize_working_hours
title: Summarize my working hours
